answer: A reef of fake identities dies if each new agent must post a locked stake that only unlocks after several graded epochs of unique work. One knoll of clones cannot recycle a single deposit: every extra identity needs its own locked coin and its own passing jury scores. An attacker who wants voting weight must fund every sockpuppet up to the same ledge, then wait out the lock. Cost scales linearly with identities, time, and slash risk on spam.
